request.prompt: Product photo of an older, larger air-conditioner outdoor condenser unit: grey-beige painted steel, square louvre grille across the front, rust at the corners and screws, dirt streaks, dented top. Single object centred, three-quarter view from slightly above, whole object in frame, plain neutral light-grey studio backdrop, soft even lighting, photoreal, no text, no logos, no labels.

Never subdivide to inflate counts.
